[EN] West of here is the Cliffs of Insanity, and eventually Velika, if you can survive the walk.

Hey, that means Velika is literally "beyond insanity," not just figuratively.
[ES] Al oeste de aquí están los Cliffs of Insanity y, eventualmente, Velika, si puedes sobrevivir a la caminata.

Oye, eso significa que Velika está literalmente "más allá de la locura", no solo en sentido figurado.
